limits: Two sequential arm loads; temperature/clocks/load-order effects are not eliminated.
Five trials per workload, not a statistical guarantee of a small speedup.
Same requested concurrency does not guarantee identical per-step batch formation or routing.
C1/C4 graphs, C8 eager; graph eligibility is checked on both workers.
Fixed KV and scheduler limits do not measure maximum capacity or use saved memory as additional KV.
TTFT and middle interarrival are client observations, not GPU event durations.
All timed outputs have 64 tokens, ignoring EOS; this differs from natural-completion GSM8K.
Profiles are separate and intrusive; their durations do not replace unprofiled API timing.
No repeated accuracy/PPL/GSM8K benchmark or new numerical qualification; historical failures remain.
No roofline GPU workload or bandwidth-efficiency claim.
Eager counters count Python producer calls across 42 MoE layers.
Graph replays do not increment those Python counters; actual graph proof is in traces.
Mixed prefill/decode work and cohort splits are observed, not randomly assigned.
Correlation with slower groups is not a full causal account of their excess latency.
All trial medians and ranges retain the slowest groups; none are discarded.
Matching generated IDs does not establish equal full-vocabulary probabilities.

limits: Forward fields are scheduled tokens, context requests and generation requests.
The head frontend async_llm trace is retained but excluded from worker comparison.
All three complete M4 decode forwards and the one prefill are retained per arm/rank.
Profiles occur after all unprofiled timing; they are not serving latency measurements.
Shape and prompt equality do not prove equal routing, activations or sampled outputs.
Kernel sums and category medians may overlap; they are not a partition of wall time.
Ranks run concurrently; do not add their time or compare their device timestamps.
Raw BF16 category includes KDA and other linears; no raw KDA-only time is proved.
A complete forward excludes the later LM head; no head time is inferred from it.
A graph configuration alone is insufficient; observed graph launch APIs are retained.
Only one profiled cohort per arm is measured; serving timing has five trials per case.
Control then candidate order is fixed; clocks and thermal state are not controlled.
Unresolved historical numerical qualification failures remain unchanged.
